architecturalFacts.name: PETRONAS Twin Towers
architecturalFacts.shape: Twin stepped towers with spires, interlocking-square/semicircle plan and a connecting double-level bridge. Parametric implementation remains approximate.
notes: Official structure page shows inconsistent 451.8 m/452 m rounding; 451.9 m is stated by the operator stories page and CTBUH.
Architectural maximum, occupied height, observation deck and bridge are distinct measures.
Published dimensions do not specify every setback, facade panel or exact bridge attachment.

architecturalFacts.name: Merdeka 118
architecturalFacts.shape: Diamond-plan, faceted glazed tower with spire.
notes: Use the developer final height, not the architect page introductory approximate 600 m wording.
Facet subdivisions and spire geometry require modelling assumptions unless surveyed/CAD data are acquired.

architecturalFacts.name: Sydney Opera House
architecturalFacts.shape: Grouped shell roofs derived from a common sphere over a raised podium.
notes: 67 m is above sea level, not a height to add blindly above podium or terrain.
Maximum dimensions do not constitute a full roof-shell CAD model.

architecturalFacts.name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
architecturalFacts.shape: Steel through-arch bridge with stone pylons and suspended deck.
notes: Arch top ASL, shipping clearance and deck width are different geometric quantities.
Approximate reconstruction must not relabel shipping clearance as exact roadway elevation.

architecturalFacts.name: BT Tower
architecturalFacts.shape: Slender cylindrical concrete shaft, upper circular floors and mast.
notes: Historic microwave dishes were removed in 2011; do not use an old dish-covered silhouette as a current exact model.

architecturalFacts.name: The Shard
architecturalFacts.shape: Tapering glazed tower with a separated-shard crown; detailed cross-section is approximate.
notes: Height alone does not determine exact plan, facade or crown shape.

architecturalFacts.name: One World Trade Center
architecturalFacts.shape: Square base, eight triangular faces, octagonal middle and rotated square upper parapet.
notes: Foot conversions are arithmetic, not claims of millimetre modelling accuracy.
The spire is included in total architectural height; do not add it twice.

architecturalFacts.name: Brooklyn Bridge
architecturalFacts.shape: Masonry towers with paired pointed arch openings, suspension main cables and diagonal stays.
notes: NPS nomination gives 276 ft 6 in; HAER table rounds tower height differently and has inconsistent parenthetical conversions.
Use measured-datum wording above high water, not unqualified building AGL.
Historic total length varies by the definition of approaches; current DOT states 6016 ft.

srtm-nasa.supports: SRTM mission context; historical elevation sampling, not current facades or calibrated visibility.

terrainLimits: NASA/USGS SRTMGL3 V003 is historical radar-surface elevation with void filling, not a present-day surveyed bare-earth model.
Native approximately 90 m raster postings are sampled on NightLens grids spaced 400 m for KL and 500 m elsewhere. Query spacing is not native resolution.
Vertical datum is EGM96; operator references using above sea level may use unspecified datums. Their values are not an exact vertical-control survey.
Vegetation and buildings can affect radar returns; no original per-sample quality flags or uncertainty are provided by this API.
The observer camera must distinguish ground/surface ASL, platform AGL, and assumed standing eye height.
The KL grid center sample of 87 m is contextual and offset from the estimated deck edge; it is not an exact tower-foundation elevation.

accessNotes.scope: Virtual scenes do not imply physical visitor access at the selected clock time. No travel opening-hours recommendation is made.

atacama.notice: Official manager page states Ckary closed until further notice after May 27, 2026 earthquake safety review; current alert layers may coexist with nominal hours. The virtual scene must not be presented as advice to enter.

panoramaAssessment.author: Shesmax / Maxim Shesterikov
panoramaAssessment.status: Research reference only; not downloaded or bundled.
limitations: 8654 by 3325 pixels; not verified as a full equirectangular sphere.
Caption/title places view at KL Tower, but camera geotag 3.158,101.712 is near the subject towers rather than KL Tower. It cannot establish an exact camera pose.
No verified compass heading, horizon pitch or stitched angular field is available; do not register the astronomical sky using this geotag.

panoramaAssessment.author: Frostpolar
panoramaAssessment.status: Research reference only; ordinary perspective photograph, not a calibrated 360-degree texture; not downloaded or bundled.
Actual spherical panorama found, but page requires licensing. Not downloaded, extracted or bundled.

renderingBoundary: No third-party photographic panorama, facade texture, article figure or surveyed mesh is bundled by these research artifacts.
Parametric landmark profiles, platform railings, materials, windows and any unmeasured foreground detail are approximations.
Published maximum dimensions constrain scale; they do not prove every visible surface or the exact design of the real city.
Do not describe a fixed-location rotating virtual camera as a measured photorealistic digital twin or a walkable surveyed reconstruction.
Static/current landmark geometry does not reconstruct historical construction. Changing the sky date does not establish that all shown structures existed then; scene vintage must be stated.
